source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 玄蛇化出，段狂受制
title: 玄蛇化出，段狂受制
purpose: 承接 SC15 的请战与挑衅：十四郎正式出手；黑色长鞭化作巨大的玄蛇；段聿铠被逼从竹楼落地、转为守势；躲在院中的拓拔野失声惊呼，白龙鹿也被惊动。全段继续保持无声视觉，不生成字幕、门额文字、咒骂台词文字或任何可读文本。

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 anchors to the corrected SC15 gate storyboard for Shisilang's outside-gate position. SH02 anchors to the Duan Yukai reveal shot so the action remains attached to the same confrontation space. SH03 anchors to the same Duan Yukai reveal for continuity. SH04 anchors to the corrected SC15 gate storyboard so hidden-observer continuity remains stable.
video_policy: If stable reference-driven I2V is unavailable, use Comfy technical still fallback for pipeline continuity and mark outputs non-production. If true I2V is restored, use only the approved storyboard image as source of truth.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or clear Chinese inscriptions inside image/video.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue, lip-sync, battle cries, insults, music, or sound effects. Chinese dialogue, narration, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
production_dialogue_lines: 青帝明鉴，十四郎恳请将这狂徒拿下。
那条鞭子竟然在刹那间变成了一条长两丈余长的黑色巨蛇！
段聿铠一招受制，先机尽失。
拓拔野大吃一惊，忍不住失声惊呼。
